create_deepseek_ocr_processor: create a DeepseekOCRProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and an image processor for multimodal OCR
build_multimodal_special_tokens: build MultimodalSpecialTokens with image token string and token ID for the DeepseekOCR processor
process_mm_data_async: process multimodal image data and input text asynchronously returning MultimodalProcessorOutput with mm_items and input_ids
load_mm_data: load multimodal data from image bytes or file paths combined with a text prompt using configured multimodal tokens
process_and_combine_mm_data: process and combine multimodal data from base output into mm_items and input_ids for model inference
